title: Saudi Aramco CRPO 127: pre-bid engineering for 2 slipover jackets and a subsea pipeline
anonTitle: Pre-bid engineering for 2 slipover jackets and a subsea pipeline, Middle East
scope: Pre-bid engineering: 2 slipover SSS jackets and a subsea pipeline.
challenge: The EPC contractor was bidding for two slipover SSS jackets and a subsea pipeline. Its estimators needed an engineered configuration, weights and quantities they could price within the tender window.
approach: Concept and configuration of the two slipover jackets.
Preliminary sizing of the subsea pipeline.
Weight estimates and MTOs in the format the estimators use.
Assumptions recorded in one register and handed over with the deliverables.
reviewNotes: Narrative drafted from the one-line scope: confirm with the project lead.
Confirm deliverables (MTO, MR, weight estimate), codes and software.
